mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden 0.5% increase in the CPIAUCSL index above its September 15, 2021 value triggers expectations of higher inflation, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 272.676 by 0.5% in the next month
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL does not cross the threshold or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) by over 5% in the next month signals robust demand and supply-side expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise >5% in the next month
failure_condition: Either proxy does not rise sufficiently or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in UNRATE above 5.5% in the next month signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing growth expectations and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% in the next month
failure_condition: UNRATE does not cross the threshold or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in RSAFS (demand) and INDPRO (supply) by over 3% in the next month indicates expanding economic activity, fostering positive investor sentiment and S&P 500 forward returns within 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and INDPRO both rise >3% in the next month
failure_condition: Either proxy does not rise sufficiently or 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS over 3 months lowers discount rates, enhancing equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Not in a late-cycle expansion regime or FEDFUNDS do not decline sufficiently, with 60-day returns not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE below its recent trend signals improving labor market conditions, boosting growth expectations and resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline sufficiently or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in INDPRO (supply) by over 2% while GDPC1 (demand) rises by over 3% in the next month signals supply-side constraints and demand-driven inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls >2% while GDPC1 rises >3% in the next month
failure_condition: Proxies do not move as specified or 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
